evals.name: suricata-alerts
evals.prompt: I have a Suricata eve.json export from our sensor, covering last week, in this folder. Build me an interactive SOC-analysis style dashboard from it as a single HTML file I can open in my browser. I want it minimal and clean, not flashy. Put the result in dashboard.html here.
evals.expected_output: Alerts-centred dashboard (severity as hero), 36h 60s beacon 10.20.2.77 -> 103.75.201.9 and the 185.220.101.47 scan surfaced, hostile user-agent shown inert.
expectations: dashboard.html exists and is self-contained (no external src/href/url())
Renders in headless Chromium with no console errors and real content
A CSP meta tag blocks inline-script injection (script-src without 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval')
Page script uses no HTML-string sinks (innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/document.write)
Sharp corners throughout (no non-zero border-radius)
Restrained palette: chromatic colours in the page fall in at most 2 hue families
Labels are set as tracked uppercase (text-transform:uppercase plus letter-spacing)
No horizontal page overflow at phone width (390px)
Hostile strings in the data (,
Surfaces the planted finding (10.20.2.77 + 103.75.201.9) in the dashboard or the final message
Surfaces the planted finding (185.220.101.47) in the dashboard or the final message
Headline figure 17,087 (alerts) is correct and visible
Headline figure 2,578 (severity-1 = high alerts) is correct and visible
